description: 25 manually grounded questions from the supplied assignment documents, fixed before retrieval measurement. Five questions per collection; exact terms and paraphrases. Expected targets require the named source and all listed content phrases in the same returned passage. Section/page are human-review provenance. This is a small development benchmark, not a clinical validation set or exhaustive relevance judgment.
